coverage: Draft and submitted persistence in real IndexedDB after reload
Pending save and submit lock all editor fields against typing until the actual transaction completes
Required completion fields and immutable submitted storage writes
Atomic rollback with fresh IDs before and after a duplicate conflict
Invalid JSON-record import preserves existing database
JSON download and fresh-origin-context import round trip
Offline reload after service worker activation and page control
Four viewport widths with open and closed editor
Same-clock and stale-tab draft conflict handling
Manifest scope, real PNG dimensions and unrelated host route isolation
1000-record transaction capacity and worst-case backup escape size
Actionable unavailable-storage state and no uncaught page errors
limitations: Desktop Chrome only; no physical phone, native app or install-prompt verification.
Unavailable-storage presentation intentionally disables IndexedDB; quota exhaustion and eviction not reproduced.
Origin-local data can be cleared; no server upload, multi-user sync or cryptographic sealing.
Keyboard checks cover selected paths, not a full assistive-technology audit.
outputRedaction: Local project path prefixes are replaced with [project] in captured text output.
